pageCoverage.coverage: L10: four objectives; six matching pictures in original order; two pair-discussion prompts.
L10 text1: scene/context, two listen-twice choices, all seven dialogue lines, picture, numbered vocabulary1–9 (10 POS records).
L10 text1: three role-reading questions. Grammar1: complete explanation, three examples, three blanks. Text2 context and two listening choices.
L10 text2: all eight lines including ellipsis, picture, numbered vocabulary10–18 (11 POS records), three role-reading questions. Grammar2 introduction.
L10 grammar2: three complete usage explanations (上/中/下), six examples, three blanks. Text3 context and two listening choices.
L10 text3: all eight lines including stage direction, picture, numbered vocabulary19–24 (seven POS records), three role-reading questions. Grammar3 introduction.
L10 grammar3: three examples and three blanks. Text4: context, two listening choices, complete three email paragraphs, camera picture, numbered vocabulary25–28 (five POS records).
L10 text4: read-aloud directive and China/own-country education-system comparison. Two word banks and all ten blanks. Picture dialogue1: three blanks.
L10 picture dialogues2–3: three blanks each. Four-person method exchange, class sharing and three voted methods. Culture topic 中国的义务教育, video10-1 and teaching scene; video unavailable.
